title: Strainer (tall clawed drain-filter stalker) - rigged runtime derivative of the accepted Meshy T2.5 model with Codex-projected textures (prototype)

status.stage: unapproved prototype derivative; art / anatomy / deformation / gameplay fit not certified
status.licenseClearance: none - a derivative of AI generations (Meshy geometry conditioned on a Codex-generated image; textures projected from two Codex-generated images); access to it grants no licence, commercial or production clearance

honesty.rig: NEW derivative skeleton (shared 18-joint naming / hierarchy of the zombie wardrobe) and automatic skin weights created by this CPU pipeline
honesty.animation: hand-authored procedural keyframes / gait functions (lib/strainer-clips.mjs) sampled with this body's own joint positions - NOT motion capture
honesty.textures: derived ONLY from two Codex-generated images (the user-approved front T-pose + the accepted Codex back view) by deterministic projection / UV baking onto the accepted mesh's existing UV layout, with nearest-surface fill of unseen texels and island padding; normal / metallic-roughness maps computed from that baked colour; no painting, no procedural or hand-drawn artwork; the Meshy provider maps are NOT used at runtime (kept private raw provenance only)
honesty.generation: no AI generation, inference, model download or network service was used by this builder; the Meshy model and the two Codex images were generated earlier by the task primaries (ledgers below)

provenance: generated (Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D geometry, smart topology, t-pose, from the project's own user-approved Codex-generated front T-pose; runtime textures projected from that front T-pose + an accepted Codex back view) + local derivative work

normal.method: height = gauss(L, blur) - gauss(L, highPassSigma) of the baked colour luminance at 1024 (island texels only); n = normalize(-strength dh/dx, +strength dh/dy, 1) (row y grows with v: glTF +Y = toward decreasing v), tilt clamped to maxTilt

metallicRoughness.method: per texel of the baked colour (HSV): pale pink / bone (hue -25..35 deg, value > 0.5) -> dull, saturated olive / yellow (hue 35..80 deg, saturation > 0.35) -> wet slime, dark crevices (value < 0.25) slightly wetter; otherwise wet skin; metallic 0

derivatives.normalConvention: glTF 2.0 tangent space: R = +X (toward increasing u), G = +Y (toward decreasing v, image up), B = +Z; verified by the builder on a synthetic dome (checkNormalConvention) and in a lit CPU render

segment.note: background = per-channel quadratic surface + per-row median offset (Gaussian-smoothed over rowSigma rows) fitted to the border band, refitted on pixels within threshold/2 of it; figure = RGB distance to the background model > threshold, minus the floor contact shadow (bottom floorZone of the figure: neutral darkening rgb ~ alpha x background with alpha >= shadowAlphaMin and chroma residual < shadowChroma); closing then opening (Euclidean disks), components >= minComponentPx kept, background holes <= holeMaxPx filled; sampling mask = figure eroded by erodePx (Euclidean)

register.note: arms posed with the builder rig (local rotations about +Z of UpperArm / Forearm / Hand, mirrored for the right side) and CPU linear-blend skinned; base projection x_img = cx +- k x (mirror for the back view), y_img = cy - k y; per region a similarity (scale s, rotation th, translation t) about its pivot joint, blended per vertex by the skin-weight share of the region; all parameters by coordinate ascent of the whole-figure silhouette IoU at workScale (steps halved when a sweep makes no progress)

bake.note: view weight = smoothstep(facing[0], facing[1], n.view) x visible x inside-pull-range; colour = weighted mean of FRONT / BACK; confidence = min(1, sum of weights); the rest from the fill

fill.note: texels with confidence < 1: colour = conf x sample + (1 - conf) x Gaussian-weighted mean of the k nearest well-sampled texels (bind-surface 3D distance; sigma = max(sigmaMin, sigmaK x d_k); well-sampled texels taken at sampleStride)

pad.note: UV islands dilated by averaging covered 8-neighbours, then the remaining empty atlas = mean island colour

normal.note: height = gauss(L, blur) - gauss(L, highPassSigma) of the baked colour luminance at 1024 (island texels only); n = normalize(-strength dh/dx, +strength dh/dy, 1) (row y grows with v: glTF +Y = toward decreasing v), tilt clamped to maxTilt

roughness.note: per texel of the baked colour (HSV): pale pink / bone (hue -25..35 deg, value > 0.5) -> dull, saturated olive / yellow (hue 35..80 deg, saturation > 0.35) -> wet slime, dark crevices (value < 0.25) slightly wetter; otherwise wet skin; metallic 0

pinnedFrom.note: the Strainer GLB of merge 859a402 (Meshy provider maps re-encoded), before the Codex texture bake

identity.method: lib/strainer-texture-identity.mjs: sha256 over every accessor / node / skin / animation / scene-extras / non-texture material parameter of the written GLB equals the pinned pre-bake GLB (only the three embedded images differ)

source.rawKeptOutsideGit: reference/ (external, ignored) - the raw GLB, its provider maps, the input image and the Codex images are not modified or shipped

providerMaps.note: Meshy provider texture maps of the raw GLB: private raw provenance only, NOT decoded or used for any runtime texture

accepted.why: first acceptable body: recognisably the approved Strainer (gaunt, tall, long clawed arms, drain-filter rib face/chest with fronds, waterlogged olive skin), whole textured single mesh, open arms and separated legs for rigging; body search STOPPED. Rig acceptance (local shared 18-joint pipeline) follows; the paid rig contingency stays unused unless the local rig genuinely fails.

glb.format: glTF 2.0 binary; KHR_mesh_quantization (NORMAL int8 normalized; required); JPEG textures; JOINTS_0 u8 / WEIGHTS_0 normalized u8; one SkinnedMesh node

metallicRoughness.format: JPEG 4:4:4 packed: G roughness, B metallic (0), R unused
metallicRoughness.source: function of the baked Codex colour

normal.format: JPEG 4:4:4 tangent-space (glTF convention, no tangents: three.js derivative tangents)
normal.source: high-passed luminance height of the baked Codex colour

conventions.bindPose: the generated T-pose (arms ~44 deg below horizontal, slightly bent knees, head / crown hunched forward)
conventions.bindRotations: identity (bone frames aligned with model space)

placement.note: scaled to 2.15 m; source faced +Z: no rotation; feet midpoint (bbox centres of soles below 4 cm) moved to origin

facing.method: sole bbox z-centre (lowest 3% of height) vs shin centroid (8-12%): toes extend toward the front

densify.method: per-edge midpoint split (consistent across shared edges, linear position/UV/normal) until every edge <= maxEdge; surface and texture mapping unchanged

landmarks.method: main body only (largest connected component, 9200 welded vertices; 254 loose strand components left out), densified to max edge 0.0045 x height and welded

skeleton.validationNote: the anthropometric ranges of autorig.validateSkeleton are for ordinary adults; this creature is deliberately long-shinned with wide-set shoulders and long forearms (out-of-range ratios are the generated proportions, not a detection failure: see the joint overlay render)

feet.method: generic (zombie/lib/skeleton.mjs): foot depth widens > 1.3x shin depth below the ankle; joint 1.5 cm under the transition, clamped 0.07..0.13 m

legs.method: crotch = lowest merge of the leg clusters; hip height = 0.49H clamped to crotch+[0.06, 0.18] (generic); hip x = 0.8 x thigh centre 4 cm below the crotch (generic), hip z = thigh-section centreline (crotch-0.25..-0.04 m) extrapolated to the hip height; knee = 0.02 m below the patella (most forward leg front surface), centred in the leg section; ankle centred in the shin section

arms.method: PCA axis of the arm between |x| 0.5..0.85 m; armpit = highest slice where the cluster on that axis (+-0.08 m) is separate from the central torso cluster; perpendicular sections every 0.01 m (+-0.006 m, points within 0.2 m) -> bbox-centre centreline + median radius; shoulder = the upper-arm centreline (sections centred 0.22..0.04 m below the armpit, torso-free) evaluated 0.02 m above the armpit; wrist = distal end of the longest run of sections thinner than 0.034 m (the palm starts there); elbow = centreline section at 0.45 of the shoulder -> wrist chord; hand end = 99.8th pct along wrist -> hand centroid; acromion = top surface 2 cm lateral of the joint

spine.method: spine joints at 30 / 66 % hip -> neck base (generic heights); z at 0.45 of the mid-sagittal depth: back skin -> first front surface (|x| < 0.04 m slab split into surface runs at > 0.03 m z gaps, so the face grille / frond curtain hanging in front of the chest is not counted); neck base 0.06 m above the shoulder joints (hunched: no narrow neck slice); head pivot at 0.4 of neck base -> top, z at 0.5 of the neck section there (back skin -> throat); head end = farthest crown point (|x| < 0.15) from the pivot

skinning.method: zombie/lib/skin.mjs region classification + chain weights + masked Laplacian smoothing on the welded source mesh (UV-seam copies share weights), + lateral Neck / Head fade, + jaw / rib-cage junction diffusion, + loose strands follow their roots

neckLateralFade.note: torso-region main-body vertices: Neck + Head weight x (1 - smoothstep(x0, x1, |x|)), the remainder to Chest

jawJunction.note: torso-region main-body vertices from Neck.y - below to Head.y + above, |x| < maxAbsX: Laplacian diffusion of the normalised Chest / Neck / Head shares (neighbours outside the zone are fixed boundary values); each vertex keeps its Chest + Neck + Head total and all other influences

strands.note: every connected component other than the main body (loose frond / grille strips) copies the 4 weights of the main-body vertex nearest to its topmost vertex (its root): strands move rigidly with what they hang from

mesh.note: the Meshy smart-topology mesh and UVs unchanged (placed: uniform scale + translation); no simplification / re-UV / re-bake

clips.method: hand-authored procedural keyframes / gait functions (lib/strainer-clips.mjs) at 30 fps, legs by foot-planting IK (zombie/lib/pose.mjs); not motion capture

runtime.note: ZombieStats.attackDuration / attackImpact should match Attack (the right claw sweeps through the front at chest height at attackHitTime; reachM = horizontal root -> claw tip at that frame, actor scale 1); locomotion clips are authored in place for groundSpeed at timeScale 1 (ai/zombieActor.ts scales by speed / (groundSpeed x actor scale), clamped 0.35..1.8)

deathSolve.method: lib/strainer-clips.mjs solveStrainerDeath (zombie/lib/clipsolve.mjs coordinate descent + cost on regionFloorReport, Strainer ranges)

floorGuard.method: per frame: Hips raised so the lowest CPU-skinned vertex stays >= 5 mm above the floor (Attack / Hit / Death)

footSkate.method: flat-foot stance frames (phase 0.15..0.75 x beta; Idle all frames): mean horizontal position of the fixed sole vertex set (bind foot vertices below 3 cm), frame-to-frame speed relative to the treadmill (the stance foot slides back at exactly groundSpeed in place); 0 = no skating

clearance.method: every 2nd frame: CPU-skinned limb vertices clear of the surface in the bind pose vs the posed surface; depth = distance behind the closest surface triangle along its outward normal (oriented by the bind vertex normals). armsVsTorso: forearm / hand vs torso above the crotch; thighsVsTorso: thigh vs torso; clawsVsLegs: hand / claw vs thigh + shin

attack.method: CPU skinning of the welded body (top-4 float weights) at every Attack frame; reach = horizontal distance from the root (feet midpoint, actor origin) to the hand-region vertex farthest from it; clawTip = that vertex; frontMostR = the right hand vertex with the largest z; centre-line crossing = when frontMostR passes x = 0 in front of the body (z > 0.4 m)

motionStretch.method: per triangle: worst edge length ratio posed / bind over every 3rd frame of all six clips (CPU skinning)

radii.method: torso: 75th pct distance of the torso core (crotch..neck, z < 0.2: not the rib cage / grille bar standing in front) to the Hips-Spine-Chest-Neck chain (capsule Hips->Neck in ai/zombieActor.ts updateVolumes); head: 75th pct distance of the head vertices to the Head joint -> head end segment (the crown points forward-down), plus the headshot sphere; limbs: autorig bodyProfile radii x1.35 (arm) / x1.4 (leg) like zombie/lib/hit.mjs (unclamped)

headSphere.method: bind pose: torso-region vertices above the neck base with Head weight >= 0.5 (the crown / face cage); centre = their bbox centre, radius = 85th pct distance to it (radiusMax = enclosing)

collider.note: motor circle radius 0.36 m (ordinary zombie 0.33, coated 0.38): covers the torso / hip core (95th pct horizontal radius of the torso + leg vertices 0.471 m; the hunched crown overhangs it forward to z 0.535 m) and passes the narrowest walk-through openings (2-cell doors, 1.0 m) with 0.14 m per side; hanging arms / claws may visually brush door jambs (no collision)

motor circle radius 0.36 m (ordinary zombie 0.33, coated 0.38): covers the torso / hip core (95th pct horizontal radius of the torso + leg vertices 0.471 m; the hunched crown overhangs it forward to z 0.535 m) and passes the narrowest walk-through openings (2-cell doors, 1.0 m) with 0.14 m per side; hanging arms / claws may visually brush door jambs (no collision)

notes: ai/zombieActor.ts updateVolumes: head sphere (r head), torso capsule Hips->Neck (r torso), limb capsules UpperArm->Hand (r arm), Thigh->Foot (r leg); the headshot sphere (bone Head + offset, radius) covers the forward-hunched crown / face cage that a sphere at the Head joint would miss
all values in model metres at actor root scale 1 (multiply by the runtime scale)

runtime.bones: same 18 names as the zombie bodies (ai/zombieActor.ts BONES all present)

limitations: Automatic approximate skin weights on a low-poly (20.5 k triangle) source: LBS volume loss at shoulders / elbows / knees in strong poses; no finger / claw / jaw bones (the claws move rigidly with the Hand; the "twitch" is wrist / forearm motion).
The loose fronds / grille strands are rigid with the body part they hang from (no secondary motion / physics); in poses far from the bind (arms hanging) the arm fronds no longer hang vertically.
Procedural (not mocap) clips; no facial rig.

Hidden-side geometry of the source is AI-generated (Meshy). The textures are projected from two Codex views (front + back) and so carry their studio lighting; surfaces seen by neither view (under the crown, inner limbs, crevices; see textures.filledFraction) are filled from the nearest projected surface and read smoother; the Codex views are separate generations, so their details only approximately agree where front and back meet at the sides.
The hunched crown overhangs the motor collider forward and the hanging claws swing outside it (visual brushing of door jambs, no collision change).
Unapproved prototype: appearance, anatomy, deformation, performance and licensing not certified; gameReady false.
